timeUnit: simulation seconds; multiply cooldown by 0.75 for real seconds at 1x; source speeds and beam DPS multiply by 0.75 on import

sizeRules.description: Game-scale ordinary gun conversion. S-size controls the base curve; matching-version model damage/RPM relative to the same size and family preserve model differences. Seconds are real time at 1x. Reviewed signature weapons, guided ordnance and interception-only PDC are excluded.
sizeRules.mounting: Each installed barrel fires its own projectile with the shared model's single-barrel damage. No merged damage or diminishing gun-count multiplier.
